Why I'm Running
## Half Moon Bay deserves leadership rooted in this community
I've called Half Moon Bay home for over two decades. I've watched our town grow, change, and face real challenges — from housing affordability to protecting the natural beauty that makes this place so special. I believe our city council should reflect the people who live here, not outside interests.
My commitment is simple: listen to residents, make decisions based on evidence and community input, and always put Half Moon Bay first. Whether it's protecting our coastline, supporting our small businesses, or ensuring our neighborhoods remain safe and vibrant — I'm in this for the long haul.
Ron Kies — Candidate for Half Moon Bay City Council, District 4
“Half Moon Bay’s greatest strength is its people. I’m running to make sure their voices are heard at City Hall.”
— Ron Kies, candidate for City Council District 4
Community First
Every decision starts with what's best for Half Moon Bay residents — not developers, not outside interests.
Transparency
Open government means showing your work. I'll hold regular town halls and publish clear updates.
Sustainability
Protecting our coastline and natural environment for the next generation of Half Moon Bay families.

Community Support
## Voices from Half Moon Bay
Neighbors, business owners, and community leaders across District 4 are standing with Ron. Add your voice to the campaign.
Ron is the only candidate in District 4 with endorsements from Coastside Democrats, San Mateo County Democrats, and is on the slate of endorsed local candidates for California Democrats.
“
Half Moon Bay needs new leadership, fresh ideas, and optimism to guide us through the challenges we face. That is why I am endorsing Ron Kies for City Council, District 4. Ron has a clear, forward-thinking vision for our city's future and the creativity to solve complex problems. He brings an open-door approach and the energy to revitalize our local government. Ron is ready to listen, ready to work, and ready to lead.
Deborah PenroseVice Mayor, City of Half Moon Bay
“
It is my pleasure to endorse Ron Kies for the Half Moon Bay City Council. Ron will bring thoughtful, collaborative, and forward-looking leadership as the Council charts a new direction for the community. His commitment to listening to residents, building consensus, and pursuing practical solutions will make him a strong and effective advocate for Half Moon Bay.
Rick BonillaFormer Mayor, City of San Mateo · Founding Board Member, Peninsula Clean Energy · 2021 Sustainability Award, Sustainable San Mateo County
Neighbors, business owners, and community leaders across District 4 are standing with Ron.

## Join the campaign for Half Moon Bay
This campaign is powered by neighbors, not special interests. Every dollar donated and every hour volunteered makes a real difference in District 4.

- Volunteer — Knock doors, make calls, or help at campaign events across District 4.
- Spread the word — Tell your neighbors about Ron and share on social media.
